title: COMPASS: Grounding Composition-Intent Guidance in Unified Multimodal Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.28696v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Composition is a high-level visual intent that governs where subjects are placed and how a scene is organized, yet current unified multimodal models remain unreliable at fine-grained composition recognition and struggle to turn such intent into controllable generation. We present COMPASS, the first unified multimodal framework that grounds composition-intent control in a single system spanning both composition perception and composition-guided generation, with a shared expert token $\tau_c$ as the central intent anchor. On the perception side, COMPASS injects composition expertise into an MoE backbone in a minimally invasive manner and distills the inferred intent into $\tau_c$. On the generation side, COMPASS reuses $\tau_c$ as a global conditioning signal that steers the denoising trajectory, effectively converting passive composition analysis into explicit layout control. translated_title: COMPASS：在统一多模态模型中落地构图意图引导
translated_abstract: 构图是一种高级视觉意图，它决定主体在场景中的放置位置以及场景的组织方式，然而当前的统一多模态模型在细粒度构图识别方面仍然不可靠，并且难以将这种意图转化为可控生成。我们提出了COMPASS，这是首个将构图意图控制落地于单一系统的统一多模态框架，该系统同时涵盖构图感知与构图引导生成，并以共享专家标记 τ_c 作为核心意图锚点。在感知方面，COMPASS以微创方式将构图专业知识注入MoE骨干网络，并将推断出的意图蒸馏到 τ_c 中。在生成方面，COMPASS将 τ_c 复用为全局条件信号来引导去噪轨迹，有效地将被动构图分析转化为显式布局控制。为了支持系统化的指令跟随构图学习……
tldr: COMPASS是首个将构图感知与构图引导生成统一于单一系统的多模态框架，通过共享专家意图锚点τ_c将构图意图从被动分析转化为可控的显式布局生成。
en_tdlr: COMPASS is the first unified multimodal framework grounding composition-intent control in a single system spanning composition perception and composition-guided generation, using a shared expert token τ_c as the central intent anchor to convert passive composition analysis into explicit layout control.
